changes: Huntress EDR integration — sync endpoint agents, organisations, and incident data. Open incidents surface automatically as anomalies on the Trends page.
ThreatLocker anomaly detection — two new anomalies: endpoints not in Secure mode and organisations with unusual deny-count spikes.
DST-aware timezone support — configure your timezone with an IANA name (e.g. Australia/Sydney, America/New_York) and ChatPSA automatically adjusts for daylight saving transitions.

Graceful sync containers — all optional sync containers (CIPP, Duo, ThreatLocker, Huntress) now start by default and wait for credentials. Configure via Admin → Settings and they begin syncing within 30 seconds — no restart needed.
Admin UI improvements — Test Connection buttons for all integrations, Sync Status tab with row counts, and a link to the full Analytics dashboard.
Documentation overhaul — step-by-step setup guides for all five integrations, administration guide, timezone configuration, reverse proxy examples, and troubleshooting.
Initial open-source release — ChatPSA is now publicly available. Natural-language queries over your ConnectWise Manage data, powered by Claude.
Multi-source data syncing — pulls data from ConnectWise Manage, CIPP/Microsoft 365, and Duo Security into a local SQLite database.
Trend and anomaly detection — surfaces ticket spikes, quiet clients, overdue tickets, unused M365 licences, and stale priority tickets automatically on the Trends page.
Timeline view — extracts future-dated events from ticket notes so you can see what's coming up across all clients.
Agent memory — ask the agent to remember anything and it persists across sessions, with per-user context so each team member has their own preferences.
Query learning — thumbs-up a response and the question and SQL are saved as a reference example. The agent's accuracy improves over time as your team uses it.
Pinned queries — save live SQL queries that re-run on every Trends page load, giving you an at-a-glance dashboard of metrics you care about.
Microsoft Entra ID authentication — sign in with your Microsoft 365 account via Azure AD. First user to sign in is automatically granted admin access.
Usage analytics dashboard — track 7-day activity, response times, error rates, peak usage hours, and AI-powered query theme clustering.
Configurable app name — set APP_NAME in your .env to customise the branding throughout the UI.
